milestone: First evidence that off-policy RL improves the StarVLA policy on held-out initial conditions.
headline: reach 0.14 -> 1.00 and grasp 0.02 -> 1.00 with non-overlapping 95% intervals; first full task success (1/25) and mean return -0.486 -> +3.871

full_success_detail.sanity: return 35.4 sits inside the 15.9-36.2 band of successful demonstration replays, so this is a real completion rather than a reward artifact

caveats: n=25 for periodic evals; the final comparison uses all 50 conditions
lift 0.08 and success 0.04 have wide intervals ([0.02,0.25] and [0.007,0.195]) -- the late-stage claim is weak at this budget
reach/grasp are the statistically solid claims at this point
entropy_controller: converged: log-prob 24.0 -> ~-7.5 against the -8.4 target, alpha regulated both directions
